chapter: Later years and the Texas scene
title: Meeting Bob Cosby, Don Redman and other bandleaders
summary: Albert shared food with Bob Cosby's hungry band and worked alongside Don Redman in Detroit; never met Lombardo.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: When you were on the road like that, did you ever meet Benny Goodman or Tommy Dorsey or Don Stratton?

No, we met Bob Cosby and what was his bad cats? I don't know if you ever would remember that, but we were doing fairly good and we had enough to eat. Bob Cosby didn't and we just stopped on the road and shared what we had. They were hitting it pretty hard.
Yeah, well you knew some of those guys probably by sight as kids. Right, right. Because a lot of those fellows were from New Orleans. Yeah, yeah. What about Don Redman? You never met him?
I played with Don. Well, not played with him. He worked along with me in Detroit, Michigan. That's where you had your big bands like Bikini Cotton Pickers, Fletcher, Harrison.
Oh, you'd be alternating at the...
What about a sweet band like Alambardo?
Never met him. I've never met him in my life.
